# Alah'thalas fishing

## Post 33824 by Kefke (Patch Note Conspiracy Theorist) — 2023-02-02T15:18:00Z
<!-- url: https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=33824#p33824 | page 1 | era: pre-1.18.1 -->

I recently noticed that when fishing in Alah'thalas, the cast would be successful, but I never get anything. I can gain skill, and it will pop up the item collection window, but it's always empty. So I'm pretty sure that the fishing table for Alah'thalas has no drops. I thought that was a shame since it makes for such a picturesque fishing spot, so I've taken it upon myself to make some suggestions as to what you might find there.

Now, my interpretation of the lore is that Alah'thalas is essentially a magically active ruin that the High Elf refugees fixed up and reinhabited. So I went at it with that in mind. I imagine that the nearby waters should have lost artifacts in them, and that maybe some of the fish have been affected by "magical pollution" from the ancient arcane devices and nearby crystal mine.

So, with that in mind, here are some things I think you should be able to fish up in Alah'thalas;

 **[Spotted Sunfish](https://www.wowhead.com/classic/item=1467/spotted-sunfish)** - Honestly just because of the "Citadel of the Sun", I'd like to include these. The problem is, they're a quest item. There is a ["Sauteed Sunfish"](https://www.wowhead.com/classic/item=1326/sauteed-sunfish) consumable, but it's only obtained from one quest, and not craftable. Assuming a recipe was added, I'd put these in, though.

 **[Deviate Fish](https://www.wowhead.com/classic/item=6522/deviate-fish)** - Normally an inland fish, but these fish are weird, and I can imagine them appearing around a concentrated source of magic. I think some weird mutant fish make a good contrast to the picturesque scenery.

 **[Mana-Gorged Sunfish](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)** - A new item for the zone, to lean into my "mana pollution" idea. Same effects as a [Cooked Crab Claw](https://www.wowhead.com/classic/item=2682/cooked-crab-claw), trading a lower sell price and higher level requirement for not needing to kill things, have a recipe, or buy spices to get it. I'm not good with the item editor, so this is just a mock-up.

 **[Quel'dorei Artifact](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)** - What is this junk? Who knows? It's old, and somebody probably wants it, so fish it up!

 **[Quel'dorei Artifact](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)** (Again) - Exactly the same as the other one, but with a different icon. How many kinds could there be?! (There's two.)

 **[Quel'dorei Meditation Charm](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)** - Another mockup, and I'm sorry but I didn't try as hard on this one. My idea was that it would give minor mana regen and a small amount of Arcane spellpower when equipped.

 **[Ancient Quel'dorei Coffer](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)** - Unique themed fishing chest with level appropriate loot. Didn't put much into this one other than to mock it up for an icon, TBH.

Other than that, there should probably be one or two more fish. Firefin, Blackmouth, and Sagefish would probably be fine. Or maybe Sunscale Salmon even though they're, again, supposed to be an inland fish, but I just wanted to get the ball rolling, since the lack of anything to catch there seems like an oversight.
